test_is_func: test the is_func utility to check if an fx.Node matches a given target function
find_specified_fn_maybe: find the first fx.Node in an iterable that matches a given OpOverload target
find_auto_fn: find the first auto_functionalized fx.Node wrapping a specific OpOverload in a graph
find_getitem: find the getitem fx.Node that extracts the idx-th element from a given node
find_op_nodes: find all fx.Node instances in a graph matching a given OpOverload including auto-functionalized wrappers
